SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   C. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
